turn1.leave-001: Full-time employees receive **24 working days of annual leave per calendar year** [Source 1].
turn1.leave-002: Employees receive **8 working days of casual leave per calendar year** [Source 1].
turn1.leave-003: Employees receive **12 working days of sick leave per calendar year** [Source 1].
turn1.leave-005: The annual leave carry-forward limit is **12 working days** into the following calendar year [Source 1]. This policy also appears in the quick reference table in Source 3. Unused annual leave exceeding this limit expires unless an exception is approved.
turn1.security-002: The minimum password length is **12 characters** [Source 1], as specified in the Password Policy section. This requirement is also explicitly listed in the Quick Policy Reference table under "Password Minimum" [Source 5].
turn1.expense-001: Expense claims should be submitted within **30 days** of the expense date [Source 1].
turn1.rhw-001: The standard hybrid schedule is **3 days in the office and 2 days remote** each week [Source 1]. Teams must agree on shared in-office days with their manager. Fully remote arrangements require approval from both the department head and People Operations [Source 1].
turn1.rhw-003: The home office equipment allowance is **400 USD** for a desk, chair, or monitor [Source 1].
turn1.lnd-001: The annual learning budget per employee is **1,500 USD** per calendar year [Source 1].
turn1.ir-001: A SEV1 page must be acknowledged within **15 minutes** by the on-call engineer [Source 1].
turn1.onb-001: The probation period is **6 months** for all new employees [Source 1].
turn1.ita-001: Company laptops are replaced every **3 years** [Source 1]. Employees receive an email notification from IT Operations when their laptop becomes eligible for refresh.
turn1.wb-002: The quarterly wellness allowance is **75 USD** per quarter [Source 1].
turn1.ahg-002: Yes, harassment can be reported anonymously through the confidential Ethics Hotline, which accepts anonymous reports 24 hours a day [Source 2].
turn1.code-001: ISS-04 requires that security updates be installed within specific deadlines after release: **critical vulnerabilities within 48 hours**, **high vulnerabilities within 7 days**, and **medium/low vulnerabilities within 30 days**. Laptops missing critical patch deadlines are quarantined until the update is installed [Source 1].
turn1.leave-004: Annual leave should normally be requested at least **5 working days in advance** through the company's leave-management system [Source 1].
